purpose: Compare the scoped Zoyku RMB reverse parser and social-credit test sample tool with accessible peer evidence without treating different policies as errors.

peer.name: LDDGO 在线中文大写数字转换阿拉伯数字
peer.retrieval: Public page fetched and exercised in a browser
declared_capabilities: 普通中文数字与财务大写
one number per line and multiple lines
large decimal input may lose fractional digits

same_input.input: 人民币陆仟零柒元壹角肆分
same_input.zoyku_canonical_uppercase: 人民币陆仟零柒元壹角肆分
same_input.basis: Peer output was observed in the browser; Zoyku output and fen value are anchored by the current parser implementation and its official-example tests.

rmb_reverse.policy_difference: LDDGO advertises broad parsing with filtering and multi-line input. Zoyku accepts a declared strict financial-uppercase subset, rejects arbitrary characters, negative values and multi-line input, and calculates integer fen without rounding.

peer.name: 365工具箱 Mock 数据生成器
peer.retrieval: Public page content fetched; no interactive form submitted
declared_capabilities: unified social credit code field with GB 32100 validation
JSON, JSONL/NDJSON, CSV and SQL INSERT output

zoyku_scope.sequence: deterministic increment; no wrap and no cross-batch uniqueness guarantee
outputs: current masked or revealed display to clipboard
limitations: no JSON, JSONL, CSV or SQL export
generated samples may collide with real registrations
the full PDY prefix is excluded conservatively

global_limits: No claim about relative accuracy or overall product quality
No claim about live registration, legal validity, SEO ranking, traffic or revenue
Peer feature descriptions are not treated as independent verification
